segment.source: It is a time of Civil War. Using fear and intimidation, the Empire seeks to impose a New Order on the galaxy. Only the Rebel Alliance stands in the way of their evil plans. Not yet willing to confront the Empire directly, the Rebels are marshalling their forces in secrecy. Even now a group of their prized Calamari Cruisers is being intercepted by a squadron of Imperial Star Destroyers. The Rebel Fleet is outnumbered but, they have a surprise... the X-Wing Starfighter!
segment.target: 這是一個內戰的時代。帝國以恐懼與威嚇，企圖將新秩序強加於整個銀河。唯有反抗軍聯盟擋在他們的邪惡計畫之前。 反抗軍尚無意與帝國正面交鋒，正秘密集結兵力。就在此刻，他們珍貴的一批卡拉馬里巡洋艦正遭到一支帝國滅星者艦隊攔截。 反抗軍艦隊寡不敵眾，但他們握有一張王牌……X翼星際戰機！

segment.source: A long time ago\nin a galaxy far, far away....
segment.target: 很久很久以前，\n在遙遠的銀河系……
